walls.source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Herentals' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140033)
walls.note: Herentals: medieval earthen wall with stone gates, reduced in 1578 to behind the Nete and given pentagonal bastions and earth sconces (the old beguinage, left outside, became a Spanish fort). Traced from the Ferraris map (1777).

landmarks.y1650: Cloth hall rebuilt after the fire of 1512 with a belfry added in 1534, used as town hall.
